content.text:
Here's a 6-slide investor deck covering the round terms and entity structure, built strictly from the confirmed investor facts on file. Where a number isn't locked yet, I've marked it [NEEDS INPUT] rather than guess.

```json
[
  {
    "type": "title",
    "title": "Gratitude, delivered.",
    "subtitle": "Round terms and entity structure",
    "notes": "Open plainly. This deck covers only the round mechanics and the two-entity structure, not the full pitch."
  },
  {
    "type": "content",
    "title": "The round",
    "body": "A Friends and Family SAFE, open now. Straight terms, no hype.",
    "bullets": [
      "Instrument: SAFE (Simple Agreement for Future Equity)",
      "Raising $3 to $5M",
      "Valuation cap: $20M post-money",
      "No discount rate",
      "Investment amount is the investor's choice; it converts at the cap in a future priced round",
      "A SAFE earns no return until it converts. No projected returns or IRR"
    ],
    "notes": "Do not state committed amounts raised so far. Do not offer any IRR or return projection if asked live."
  },
  {
    "type": "content",
    "title": "An optional gift, kept separate",
    "body": "Investors can also choose to make a direct gift to ActivateGratitude.org, entirely separate from the SAFE.",
    "bullets": [
      "The gift amount is the investor's choice",
      "No equity, discount, or SAFE term attaches to it",
      "There is no fixed split between investment and gift",
      "Tax treatment: [NEEDS INPUT], pending confirmation of 501(c)(3) status and attorney review"
    ],
    "notes": "Never state the gift is tax deductible. Keep the gift framed as unconditional, not a giving incentive tied to the SAFE."
  },
  {
    "type": "two-column",
    "title": "Two entities, two jobs",
    "left": {
      "heading": "Gratitude.com, Inc.",
      "bullets": [
        "Delaware C-Corp",
        "B Corp PENDING (not certified)",
        "Makes participation possible",
        "Builds the platform: technology, enterprise customers, consumer experience, revenue, scale"
      ]
    },
    "right": {
      "heading": "ActivateGratitude.org",
      "bullets": [
        "The charitable entity",
        "501(c)(3) determination: [NEEDS INPUT], not yet granted",
        "Makes the impact possible",
        "Charitable funding, trusted nonprofit partners, delivery capacity, verification"
      ]
    },
    "notes": "One creates enterprise value, the other creates public trust. Enterprise funds growth, philanthropy funds impact. Never call ActivateGratitude.org a confirmed 501(c)(3)."
  },
  {
    "type": "stats",
    "title": "Use of funds",
    "stats": [
      {"value": "60%", "label": "Product & Engineering"},
      {"value": "20%", "label": "Growth & Partnerships"},
      {"value": "10%", "label": "Operations"},
      {"value": "10%", "label": "Partner Network"}
    ],
    "notes": "These percentages carry from the 7/20/26 deck. Confirm against the current deck before this goes external. SAFE capital funds product build and launch operations; gifts fund nonprofit seeding separately."
  },
  {
    "type": "closing",
    "title": "The round is open",
    "subtitle": "gratitude.com",
    "body": "Fund the round, and choose whether to add a gift to ActivateGratitude.org. Straight terms, straight math.",
    "notes": "Close on a clear, single ask: fund the SAFE, gift is optional and separate. Direct follow-up to Michael Hilf, mhilf@gratitude.com."
  }
]
```

This stays inside the locked facts: no committed-capital numbers, no founder commitment (it's removed), no reserve or flow-of-funds specifics since that language is still pending attorney review, and both entity statuses are marked exactly as unconfirmed where required.

You can download this as a branded PowerPoint or PDF. Tell me if you want a fuller version added after this (market size, mechanism, roadmap) to make it a complete investor deck rather than just the terms and structure section.
